creative_brief.emotional_promise: A quiet sleepy cloud opens with one calm gesture into a pocket-sized flash of weather, making discovery feel inevitable and easy to repeat.
creative_brief.format_rationale: Four compact pages give each hidden-mechanism task its own reading beat—identify and assemble, reveal and reset, then recover and care—while remaining small enough to live beside the pocket toy.
creative_brief.physical_format: Four-page A6 portrait mini-guide, 105 × 148 mm, no bleed, with 9 mm safe margins.
teaching_arc: Promise the one-twist reveal with the exact deployed silhouette
Name and count all three included pieces
Identify the square opening and small guide pin before assembly
Guide the clockwise quarter-turn and gentle stop
Reverse the motion to reset and separate in service order
Resolve jams or loose fit, then pack away, care, and use safely
typography: Headings — embedded Bitstream Vera Sans Bold
Body — embedded Bitstream Vera Sans Roman
Asides — embedded Bitstream Vera Sans Italic
creative_brief.visual_motif: Exact Made silhouettes sit inside rounded weather windows; bold shape names, numbered actions, leader lines, and state labels preserve every instruction without relying on color.

findings: Page 4 hid the complete Care paragraph beneath the safety panel.
Page 3’s clockwise arrowhead obscured STOP GENTLY, while Page 1 showed a missing-glyph box.
Page 2 named alignment landmarks without showing the square opening and small guide pin.
resolved_changes: Reflowed and shortened Page 4 so larger troubleshooting copy, complete care guidance, and safety guidance are all visible.
Replaced the unsupported cover glyph with words and moved the directional arrow above its complete clockwise instruction.
Added an annotated exact bolt render with leader lines to the square opening and small guide pin, then repeated the drive alignment in Step 3.
